primary_text: "Interest rates make me nervous about committing to a purchase right now." Everyone's waiting for rates to drop. But while you wait, property prices are rising and rent keeps increasing. The cost of waiting could be worse than the current rate. Off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina let you lock in today's price with just a deposit. You don't settle until the build completes — giving rates time to move. 20km from Melbourne CBD, near Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel. Time in the market beats timing the market.
description: Lock in the price today with a deposit while rates have time to settle
